posts.headline: Sixteen straight editions of complete radio silence from One Nut Barner, and Put it in Ra's league-best 20-8 record with a 1.5 average finish is officially the loudest quiet act in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: A 0.714 win percentage and back-to-back top-2 finishes and this man still won't say a word — Week 1 is live, the excuses are gone, let's see if the roster talks for him.

posts.kicker: CHAUNCEY, LIVE AND ON THE CLOCK
posts.headline: talentedtenthh's new roster kicks off real football carrying the single worst résumé in the league, and the untalented tenth still hasn't earned an ounce of patience.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish don't get erased by fresh draft picks — Chauncey needs actual wins now that the games count.

posts.headline: Told you all week the clock was running out — now Sasinci's title banner has to survive Week 1 with Big Head's 13-15 career record hanging over it like a storm cloud.
posts.detail: One ring doesn't cover for a below-.500 career mark, and Megamind's threat-to-quit reputation means the first bad beat could send him spiraling before the season even gets rolling.

posts.headline: The Clown Show kept its name and its cosplay into real Week 1, and the Alaskan Bull Worm finally has a scoreboard that doesn't care about vibes or Packers gear.
posts.detail: A middling 15-13 career record and a résumé that peaked with one title finish (1st) but bottomed out at 7th means this is prove-it season, not highlight-reel season.

posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie's rebrand energy is loud, but the African Bald Fraud has been parked at exactly 4th-place average finish for two straight years and Week 1 needs to break that pattern.
posts.detail: A 15-13 record with zero variance in finish (always 4th) screams 'comfortable mediocrity' — either this roster breaks the mold or the Bald Fraud bit writes itself again.
